newsitem.title: USA: Schwab in talks with three banks on IPOs - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Schwab in talks with three banks on IPOs - WSJ.

text.p: Charles Schwab is in final negotiations with three investment banks to offer its customers a part of the banks' initial public offering underwritings, the Wall Street Journal reported.
The paper said in its electronic edition that the banks are Credit Suisse First Boston, J.P. Morgan and Hambrecht & Quist.
Deals between Schwab and the three banks may be completed as early as next week, the paper said.
To date Schwab has been able to give its customers only limited entry to the ground floor of hot new stocks, the paper said.
